risk: Model under-scores churn risk for a protected segment
framework: EU AI Act Art.10, GDPR Art.22, ISO 42001
control: Quarterly disparate-impact testing across demographic segments; remediation plan if variance exceeds threshold

risk: High-value offer issued without human review
control: £50/month auto-approval threshold; hard system block above it, routed to CX queue

risk: Training data drift degrades score accuracy
control: Monthly performance monitoring dashboard; retrain triggered on accuracy drop >5%

risk: Customer cannot obtain explanation for a negative outcome
framework: EU AI Act Art.13, GDPR Art.22
control: Model card + plain-language decision rationale generated per decision

risk: Payment metadata inadvertently expands PCI scope
control: Field-level data flow mapping; tokenisation validated at ingestion; no raw PAN in pipeline
kri: Any raw PAN detected in pipeline

risk: Model reused for a new purpose without re-assessment
control: Change-control gate — new AI Impact Assessment mandatory before repurposing
kri: Any repurposing request without AIA on file

risk: Third-party enrichment source introduces unvetted PII
control: Signed DPA + AI risk questionnaire before onboarding; annual vendor re-assessment
Documented accepted risk; monitored via complaint/appeal volume as leading indicator
